name: Card
summary: One self-contained entity (an account, an order, a place), optionally actionable as a whole.

action.description: Activating the card as a whole (e.g. open details)

whenToUse: Items in a Collection that each represent an entity
A single entity summary in a larger surface
whenNotToUse: Tabular data with many attributes: use Table

accessibility.role: article (or link/button when it has an action)
requirements: When actionable, the whole card is one target; nested actions are not allowed then

agent: Activate the card by its title.
rendering: If 'action' is set, children must not contain Actions (one target per card)

mappings.ios: GroupBox, or a Button/NavigationLink with card styling in lists
mappings.android: Card / ElevatedCard / OutlinedCard (onClick variant when actionable)
